rationale: Negative sample: highway gantry contains overhead road signs but no traffic lights - must ignore
Ensure no bounding box is drawn on highway signs or street lamps
Night city street: high pressure sodium street lamps on curved poles must be ignored (no box)
Night city street: main intersection traffic light is red for ego lane - mislabeling green causes fatal crash
Bounding box must be tight around the physical signal head without enclosing the pole or halo glare
Snowy daytime: distant snow-covered traffic head with low contrast and unreadable color must be unknown
Snow glare and weather obstruction require flagging needs_review for human expert QA
Dawn/dusk: left-turn signal is red while straight is green - mislabeling as ego_relevant causes phantom braking
Dawn/dusk: straight signal head is green for ego lane - planner requires correct green to proceed
Night intersection: near foreground signal is green and directly controls current ego movement
Night intersection: distant background signal at next block is red - must NOT label as ego_relevant to prevent false stop
